name: Sibylle
bio: A ranged summoner who deploys a Chaotic Thunderorb alongside damage fields, and can strike the orb directly to redirect damage into every enemy linked to it — built for clearing groups rather than single targets.

skills.name: Divine Conqueror
skills.desc: Deals Electro Damage to enemies in front and creates a [Legion's Punishment] field at the damage locations.

skills.name: Stormcaller
skills.desc: Summons [Summon: Chaotic Thunderorb]. A maximum of 1 can exist at a time. Use [Might of Thunder] to summon an enhanced [Summon: Chaotic Thunderorb]. The enhanced [Summon: Chaotic Thunderorb] triggers [Devastating Storm] every 2s (decreased interval) with increased Link Damage.

skills.name: Might of Thunder
skills.desc: Grants up to 300 [Might of Thunder] points when dealing damage with Bonus Effects. [Divine Conqueror] and [Stormcaller] can be empowered by consuming [Might of Thunder] points.

skills.name: Master of Stormclouds
skills.desc: When the [Chaotic Thunderorb] takes damage from [Thunderbolt], increases the Damage Taken Transfer ratio by #3, up to 4 times.

skills.name: Divine Retribution
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby Electro teammate(s).
